title: Clarion Builds' Resto-Mod BMW 2002 - OneTake
description:
The 2002: BMW's first real three-box sports coupe set the standard for BMW's Ultimate Driving Machine ethos for the next forty years. While American cars did it with displacement, the 2002 was light, nimble, high-revving and fun. 

The "Clarion Builds" division of the popular car stereo company should be applauded for doing this build right. The car looks, feels, and drives like a million bucks.
author: TheSmokingTire
